text:
Next Thursday I'm moderating Agents in Production, Part 3, hosted by the NYC Applied AI Guild.

The question on the table: what actually breaks when a company moves an AI agent from pilot to production, and who gets paged when it does?

The panel:

→ Renata Okonkwo-Hale, head of AI at Brindlecove Health, a 400-person health-benefits company
→ Jonas Vellacourt, co-founder of Tessaline, which sells evaluation software for AI agents
→ Aiko Strandberg, staff engineer at Ferrowind, a freight-payments company

Pilots are easy to love. Production is where ownership, monitoring, and on-call rotations get real, and I want to push the panel to be specific about all three.

Thursday at 6:30 pm, at a co-working space in Chelsea. Free.

RSVP link is in the comments. If you have a production story or a question you want me to put to the panel, send it my way.
